combo1.title: Energy Shocker: One-Card Sleepy Scapegoats Lock
combo1.description: Going second, while your opponent controls a monster. Sleepy Scapegoats brings Swiftwind Panther Warrior out of the Deck along with 3 Tokens. Panther Tributes a Token to Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from the Deck. Panther is still on your field and mentions Dark Time Wizard, so the Trap lock is on before Energy Shocker's summon effect activates, and your opponent can't chain a Trap to the wipe. Starting hand: Sleepy Scapegoats.

steps.text: Activate Sleepy Scapegoats (Quick-Play Spell) from your hand in your Main Phase. Your opponent controls a monster, which its second half needs.
It resolves: Special Summon the first of 3 Sacrificial Sheep Tokens in Defense Position. Up to 4 are allowed; 3 keeps a Monster Zone free.
Special Summon the second Sacrificial Sheep Token.
Special Summon the third Sacrificial Sheep Token.

Your opponent controls a monster, so also Special Summon Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck. Your Extra Deck is locked for the rest of the turn, but Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed is still allowed.
Sleepy Scapegoats goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior (Quick Effect). This is your opponent's last chance to chain a Trap, such as Infinite Impermanence on Panther.
Tribute a Sacrificial Sheep Token as the cost. The Tokens only can't be Tributed to Normal Summon a monster, so paying Panther's cost with one is legal.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck.

Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy all Traps your opponent controls (Set cards are revealed first) and gain 300 ATK for each card destroyed. Panther is on your field and mentions Dark Time Wizard, so the lock is already on: your opponent can't activate Trap Cards or effects in response, from the hand, field or Graveyard.

End of the line. Energy Shocker (2400 + 300 per destroyed Trap) and Panther can both attack, because a monster was Tributed this turn. Your Normal Summon is unused and Monster Zone 5 is free. If a card you control that mentions Dark Time Wizard would be destroyed by battle or a card effect, you can destroy one of the 2 remaining Tokens instead.

combo2.title: Energy Shocker: Alligator's Dragon Knight Push
combo2.description: Going second with two cards. Revealing Energy Shocker Special Summons Alligator's Dragon Knight, whose search sets up Dark Time Wizard and Foolish Graverobber. Dark Time Wizard finds Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Panther Tributes the Dragon Knight for Energy Shocker, and the Dragon Knight in the Graveyard keeps the lock on even if Panther is removed later. Foolish Graverobber then Sets one of the Traps Energy Shocker destroyed onto your field. Starting hand: Alligator's Dragon Knight + Jinzo - Energy Shocker.

cards.name: Any Trap from your opponent's Graveyard

steps.text: Reveal Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your hand. Its text mentions Dark Time Wizard, so Alligator's Dragon Knight can Special Summon itself from your hand.
Activate effect: Alligator's Dragon Knight was Special Summoned. It adds two Spells/Traps with different names that mention Dark Time Wizard.
Add Dark Time Wizard from your Deck to your hand.
Add Foolish Graverobber from your Deck to your hand.
Then discard 1 card: Foolish Graverobber. Its Graveyard effect has no turn restriction, so it's live later this turn.
Activate Dark Time Wizard from your hand and choose its first effect.
It resolves: add Swiftwind Panther Warrior from your Deck to your hand.
Dark Time Wizard goes to the Graveyard. It returns to your hand during the End Phase.
Normal Summon Swiftwind Panther Warrior.
Activate effect: Swiftwind Panther Warrior (Quick Effect). This is your opponent's last chance to chain a Trap.
Tribute Alligator's Dragon Knight as the cost.
Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your hand.

Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy all Traps your opponent controls (Set cards are revealed first) and gain 300 ATK for each. Panther on the field and Alligator's Dragon Knight in the Graveyard both mention Dark Time Wizard, so your opponent can't activate Traps in response.
Activate effect: Foolish Graverobber in your Graveyard. Banish it.
Set one Spell/Trap from your opponent's Graveyard to your field, such as a Trap Energy Shocker just destroyed. The lock only stops your opponent, so you can activate it on their turn.
Battle Phase: Energy Shocker and Panther attack (Panther can, because a monster was Tributed this turn). In the End Phase, Dark Time Wizard returns from your Graveyard to your hand.

combo3.title: Legacy Bridge: Jinzo - Jector Backrow Check
combo3.description: Going second into Set cards, using the classic Jinzo engine only. Jector searches Energy Shocker, reveals your opponent's Set cards, and Special Summons Energy Shocker if any of them are Traps. The destroyed Traps then turn on Jinzo the Machine Menace's own summon. No monster here mentions Dark Time Wizard, so Energy Shocker wipes the backrow but doesn't lock Traps. Starting hand: Jinzo - Jector + Jinzo the Machine Menace.

steps.text: Normal Summon Jinzo - Jector.
Activate effect: Jinzo - Jector, Tributing it as the cost.
Add Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your Deck to your hand. It's a "Jinzo" monster, so Jector can fetch it.

Jector's effect continues: reveal every Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zones. At least one is a Trap, so Special Summon Jinzo - Energy Shocker from your hand. With 2 or more Traps revealed, you could Special Summon Jinzo the Machine Menace alongside it.

Activate effect: Jinzo - Energy Shocker was Special Summoned. Destroy all Traps your opponent controls and gain 300 ATK for each. No monster of yours mentions Dark Time Wizard, so there's no lock: your opponent can still chain the Traps being destroyed.
The destroyed Traps are now in your opponent's Graveyard, so Jinzo the Machine Menace can Special Summon itself from your hand. It's Level 6 until the end of the turn.

Battle Phase: Energy Shocker (2400 + 300 per Trap) and Machine Menace (2400) attack. Keep Menace on the field afterwards. If your opponent removes Energy Shocker on their turn, Menace can Tribute itself in their Main Phase to revive it from your Graveyard, where Energy Shocker's name is "Jinzo".
